e.title: tailloss
e.summary: 聚合损失上尾概率估计（CRAN 1.0）：Panjer 递归/Monte Carlo/Markov/Cantelli/Chernoff 界——再保险定价尾部方法
e.summary_en: Upper-tail aggregate loss probability (CRAN 1.0): Panjer recursion/Monte Carlo/Markov/Cantelli/moment/Chernoff bounds — reinsurance tail methods
e.summary_hk: 聚合損失上尾概率估計（CRAN 1.0）：Panjer 遞歸/Monte Carlo/Markov/Cantelli/Chernoff 界——再保險定價尾部方法
e.body: tailloss（CRAN 1.0，Gollini & Rougier）估计聚合损失分布上尾的概率：Panjer 递归、Monte Carlo 模拟、Markov 界、Cantelli 界、矩界、Chernoff 界等多种方法——再保险定价与偿付能力资本的核心尾部问题。对 RIAA：聚合损失尾部的方法集——[[aggregate-python]]（聚合分布）的 R 对照（Panjer 递归同类）；尾部概率（超高损失）决定再保险层定价（[[reinsurance]]）与偿付能力资本（[[ggsolvencyii]]）；多界方法（Markov/Cantelli/Chernoff）在数据不足时给保守估计；与 [[pareto-r]]（分段 Pareto 层匹配）、[[gb2]]（损失分布）配套；适合再保险与资本建模方向。
e.body_en: tailloss (CRAN 1.0, Gollini & Rougier) estimates the probability in the upper tail of the aggregate loss distribution: Panjer recursion, Monte Carlo simulation, Markov bound, Cantelli bound, moment bound, Chernoff bound — the core tail problem of reinsurance pricing and solvency capital. For RIAA: the method set for aggregate-loss tails — the R counterpart of [[aggregate-python]] (Panjer recursion of the same kind); tail probabilities (extreme losses) drive reinsurance layer pricing ([[reinsurance]]) and solvency capital ([[ggsolvencyii]]); the multiple bound methods (Markov/Cantelli/Chernoff) give conservative estimates when data is scarce; pairs with [[pareto-r]] (piecewise Pareto layer matching) and [[gb2]] (loss distributions); suits reinsurance and capital modelling.
e.body_hk: tailloss（CRAN 1.0，Gollini & Rougier）估計聚合損失分佈上尾的概率：Panjer 遞歸、Monte Carlo 模擬、Markov 界、Cantelli 界、矩界、Chernoff 界等多種方法——再保險定價與償付能力資本的核心尾部問題。對 RIAA：聚合損失尾部的方法集——[[aggregate-python]]（聚合分佈）的 R 對照（Panjer 遞歸同類）；尾部概率（超高損失）決定再保險層定價（[[reinsurance]]）與償付能力資本（[[ggsolvencyii]]）；多界方法（Markov/Cantelli/Chernoff）在數據不足時給保守估計；與 [[pareto-r]]（分段 Pareto 層匹配）、[[gb2]]（損失分佈）配套；適合再保險與資本建模方向。
e.verified_note: CRAN 官方页面核实（v1.0，聚合损失上尾/多界方法），未实测
